findings.finding: Header/row column desync at ≤900px. src/dashboard.ts:209 hides `.thead div:nth-child(4|5)` and `.trow > div:nth-child(4|5)`. The campaigns HEADER (src/dashboard.ts:542) is a bare <div> with an inline grid and NO .thead class, so only the ROW (src/dashboard.ts:550, class="trow") loses cells. Measured left offsets at 768: header «الجمهور»@202 over value «٠٪»@202, header «مشاهدة»@120 over the progress bar@120, header «ردود»@39 over the «⇥» button@39; headers «التقدّم» and the action column pushed to -87 and -143. The true audience (٤) and true seen-rate (١٠٠٪) are not rendered at all. Same at 375, where the grid also runs off the inline edge inside its 900px-min-width scroller. At 1440 all eight columns align exactly — this is purely the ≤900px path.

Two numeral systems on the screens the demo traverses. #kmon/<id> renders its hero KPIs in Western digits («100%», «0%», «4», «1 توصية», «جهات الاستهداف 4 من 4») directly beside Arabic-Indic filter chips («الكل (٤)», «شوهدت (٤)», «شوهدت دون ردّ (٤)») — both systems inside one visual band. #home 90 Arabic-Indic vs 62 Western. The list he opens FROM is clean; the page he opens INTO is not.

Reclassify has a lost-update race against the 5s poll. Reproduced on run 1: 2.5s after the click the toast said «نُقلت … وخرجت من أرقام الأداء» while the row, the «فعلية (١)» tab and the «١ حملة» pill all still showed the old state (scratchpad/cpo-after-click.png). Cause: setCampClass mutates `campaigns` optimistically and calls render(false), but an in-flight refresh() (setInterval 5s, src/dashboard.ts:1795) then resolves with `campaigns = await cr.json()` fetched before the POST landed, and repaints the stale list. Self-corrects on the next tick (run 2 was correct from t+1s through t+16s), so the window is ≤~5s — but it is a success message over an unchanged screen, on the one brand-new control of the round.
«١ حملة فعلية» and the «١ حملة» pill. MSA for n=1 is «حملة فعلية واحدة»; digit-plus-singular reads as an untranslated template.

.sparse (src/dashboard.ts:111) mitres a 3px border-inline-start against a 1px border across a 12px radius; at 3x the teal accent visibly detaches from the card outline at both inline-start corners and reads as a seam rather than an accent.

At 1440 the card bottom lands near y=580 in a 900px viewport, leaving ~320px of empty canvas. Honest, and the sparse line explains it — but a top-tier marketing tool would put the next action there rather than nothing.

src/index.ts:162 — `tracker.findContact(p)?.test` is falsy for a phone with no contact record yet, so allSandbox is false and a rehearsal to brand-new sandbox numbers is still born «فعلية», re-polluting the list. An evidence file that asserts what it did not measure. The three kmonlist baselines (.orbit/qa/baselines/kmonlist-{1440x900,768x1024,375x812}.png) were written 2026-08-13 02:50 — this round — and I opened the 1440 one: it already contains the NEW design (sparse explainer, no pager, status dot, Arabic-Indic digits), differing from the 03:01 'actual' only by the wall clock (٠٢:٤٧:١٠ vs ٠٣:٠١:٣٠). Those three comparisons therefore compare the build to itself and can only ever detect the clock ticking; the 0.000802 / 0.000621 / 0.003823 ratios are not evidence the redesign is safe. Yet all 15 rows carry `measured_before_rebaseline == mismatch_ratio` and `baseline_note: "real comparison against the frozen baseline"`. Re-baselining an intentionally redesigned screen is legitimate; labelling it as a frozen-baseline comparison is not. The other 12 rows are genuine.

«بروفات» in the sparse line. VOICE-REFERENCE requires the register of his own approved template — precise MSA, «one word per concept across every screen». That sentence names the same object three ways («حملة تجريبية», «بروفات», the tab «تجريبية»), and «بروفة» is colloquial theatre vocabulary, foreign to a formal Saudi healthcare-B2B register. Everything else in the line is correct: factual, no hype, no emoji, and «ولا تدخل في أرقام الأداء» is exactly the honesty rule.

Checked for and did NOT find: dead buttons (the ⇥/↩ both fire and persist), placeholder data shown as real (all 11 campaigns and 20 contacts are ledger rows), TODO stubs, filler copy, purple-gradient genericism, tests that assert nothing beyond M3. I also chased a suspected Arabic typo «رذ» seen in the render and confirmed it is a false alarm — the source is «ردّ» at src/dashboard.ts:654 and :670, the shadda glyph misread at 1x. Not filed.

Projection risk. Above 900px the campaigns list is clean, so a 1280/1920 projector is safe. The exposure is a browser window that is not maximised, a tablet, or his phone passed around the table — all normal in a team demo, and all land on «الجمهور: ٪٠».

Traversal risk, and higher than M1: the demo's most likely single click is list → campaign detail, and that page is where the two numeral systems sit side by side. He has twice rejected work as 'horrible design'; mixed numerals in an Arabic-first product is exactly that register of complaint.

The one real campaign shows ٪٠ replies. That is honest and the detail page frames it well («أُرسلت، وبانتظار الرد الأول.» plus a concrete next step). Not a defect — but he should be ready for the question, because the screen invites it.

A control that writes correctly but can leave a success toast over an unchanged screen for up to ~5s. The round's own thesis is «a control that cannot move is worse than no control»; this is its milder cousin and deserves the same standard.

Earned credit where it is due: the tab counts, the count pill and the sparse sentence all agree; the status dot carries a real aria-label; the footer «الأرقام تُحدَّث لحظيًا من حالات تسليم واتساب. لا تقديرات.» is precisely the caption discipline of user-model R2; 0 console errors across every route I loaded; the campaign detail page (verdict banner → 6 KPIs → next step → filterable audience → conversation link) is genuinely reference-grade information design.

scores.rationale: intent_fidelity 7 — the list itself now reads as deliberate and every individual claim about it holds; but the ask was «fix ALL issues», and one click away the product speaks two numeral systems. completeness 6 — the digit fix and the demo-safety work both stop at the single screen that was edited, and the ≤900px path was never looked at. coherence 6 — an Arabic-first RTL product rendering «4 من 4» beside «الكل (٤)» in one band is incoherent by definition. taste 7 — the sparse explainer is a mature, honest device and the status dot is the right answer to a fake toggle. surprise 5 — the in-UI reclassify genuinely removes an authenticated curl from the founder's workflow, which he never asked for and will use. ACCEPT requires intent_fidelity AND completeness ≥ 8; both fall short independently of the must findings.

campaigns_page_demo_verdict: Split. The campaigns LIST at 1440 is demo-safe: I looked at it by eye against QA's capture and my own, and it reads as deliberate, not broken. The sparse line is the reason — it converts a one-row table from 'the data failed to load' into 'this is all that has been launched, and here is where the rest lives', which is the honest framing rather than a cover story. The dead pager is gone, the fake switch is gone, the digits are one system, the footer states the data source. The design critique 'EMPTY/BROKEN, not honest' is answered at that width. The campaigns SURFACE as a whole is NOT demo-safe: at ≤900px the row mislabels which number is which, and the campaign detail page one click away mixes Western and Arabic-Indic numerals in the same visual band. Both are shallow fixes, neither is a redesign.

change_orders.order: Make the campaigns grid header hide the same cells its rows hide below 900px. Today src/dashboard.ts:209 hides `.thead div:nth-child(4|5)` and `.trow > div:nth-child(4|5)`, but the campaigns header at src/dashboard.ts:542 is a bare <div> with no .thead class, so only the row sheds cells and every value lands under the wrong Arabic label. Preferred fix: give that header div its own class (e.g. `camphead`) and add one media rule hiding its 4th and 5th children, so this grid's responsive behaviour is not coupled to the shared .thead/.trow rule that four other tables depend on. Adding `class="thead"` also works because the inline grid-template-columns beats the media override — but it drags in .thead's background/border/type and couples two unrelated tables, so prefer the dedicated class. Anchored string replacement only (decision 0001). Then RE-MEASURE, do not eyeball: assert at 768 and 375 that every visible header's left offset equals the left offset of the value beneath it, and that «الجمهور» renders «٤» and not a percentage.

Finish the numeral unification the commit message already claims. Route every rendered integer and percentage through fmtN (and add a percent sibling, e.g. fmtPct, so «٪» formatting is one function) on #kmon/<id> FIRST — it is the screen the demo clicks into — then #home, then #aimkt and #kb. Concretely on #kmon/<id>: the six KPI tile values and their «N% من جهات الاستهداف» sublines, the «N توصية» badge, «جهات الاستهداف 4 من 4», and the recommendation sentence «أعد استهداف 4 جهة شاهدت دون ردّ». Verify the way I did rather than by reading the diff: load each route and assert zero Western digits in #body innerText after stripping phone numbers. Current state for your baseline — #kmon 19/0, #kmon/5 33/27, #home 90/62, #aimkt 6/30, #kb 0/16 (arabic-indic/western).

Make .orbit/qa/delivery-evidence.json tell the truth about its own three kmonlist rows. They were re-baselined this round (baseline files written 02:50, actuals 03:01, and the baseline image already contains the new design), so `measured_before_rebaseline` must NOT equal `mismatch_ratio` and `baseline_note` must not say «real comparison against the frozen baseline». Either (a) re-run those three against the a71cd51 baseline and record the real pre-rebaseline delta, or (b) state plainly that the campaigns list was intentionally redesigned, that the prior baseline is superseded, and that the residual 0.0008/0.0006/0.0038 measures the live clock and nothing else. Leave the other 12 rows alone — they are genuine. This is the same honesty standard the product's own captions hold themselves to («لا تقديرات»).

Drop «وبروفات» from the sparse line at src/dashboard.ts:522. One concept, one word: «١٠ حملة تجريبية محفوظة في تبويب تجريبية ولا تدخل في أرقام الأداء.» «بروفة» is colloquial and is the only word on that screen outside the register of the founder's own approved template.

Close the reclassify race in src/dashboard.ts:583. Either await refresh(true) after a 2xx instead of mutating `cp.test` optimistically, or give refresh() a monotonically increasing request id and discard any response whose id is not the latest — the second is better because the same stale-overwrite window exists for every other write the page makes. Reproduce first so you know you fixed it: click ⇥, sample the row count and the «فعلية (N)» tab at 500ms intervals for 6s, and assert the screen never contradicts the toast.
Special-case n=1 in the sparse line and the count pill: «حملة فعلية واحدة» / «حملة واحدة» rather than «١ حملة فعلية» / «١ حملة».

Give .sparse (src/dashboard.ts:111) a clean inline-start accent — either drop the 1px border on that edge, or use a pseudo-element/inset box-shadow so the 3px teal does not mitre against 1px grey across the 12px radius.
Consider filling the ~320px below the card at 1440 with the surface's own next action (promote a rehearsal, or the campaign's pending follow-up) rather than empty canvas.

In src/index.ts:162, decide explicitly what an unknown phone means for allSandbox instead of letting `?.test` fall through to false. Cannot be proven without a send, so make it a unit test over tracker state, never a live launch.

QA D2 downgraded, not dismissed: #customers defaults to showTest=false with 4 real and 16 test contacts, but the campaign's own detail page lists all 4 targets with a «المحادثة ←» link, so the demo path is whole and this is not demo-blocking. Revisit after the demo.

user_model_updates: 2026-08-13 round-17 @0be3226 [against Rule 6, FOURTH consecutive occurrence — rule reinforced, keep at Rule 6]: the round's own commit line is «One numeral system per screen on the campaigns list». It is true, and it is true of exactly the one screen that was edited. #home (90 Arabic-Indic / 62 Western), #kmon/<id> (33/27), #aimkt (6/30) and #kb (0/16) all still mix, and #kmon/<id> is one click from the fixed screen — it is where the demo goes next. This is Rule 6's exact shape a fourth time: the leak is closed on the surface that was touched, the spill is still on every adjacent surface. The generalisation to carry into future rounds: when a fix is expressed as a page-level PROPERTY («one numeral system per screen», «no fake controls», «honest empty states»), the property must be asserted across every screen that shares the property, not only the screen under edit — and the assertion must be a measurement, not a claim.

2026-08-13 round-17 @0be3226 [new — responsive parity is an unwatched blind spot]: the ≤900px header/row desync has been live since at least a71cd51, through several UI rounds and a QA matrix that captures all three viewports every time. It survived because the checks assert page-level properties (landmark present, no page-level horizontal overflow, 0 console errors) and this defect lives INSIDE an overflow-x:auto card, where a page-level overflow check is structurally blind to it. Process lesson for the QA playbook, not a builder failure: responsive evidence must assert intra-component alignment (header offset == cell offset) at each breakpoint, not merely that the page rendered.

user_impact_summary_ar:
قائمة الحملات صارت جاهزة للعرض على شاشة الاجتماع بعرض ١٤٤٠. راجعتها بعيني وقارنتها بلقطتي الحيّة: لم تعد تبدو كصفحة لم تكتمل، بل كصفحة تشرح نفسها — سطر واحد يقول «هذه القائمة تعرض حملة فعلية واحدة فقط، وهي كل ما أُطلق حتى الآن، والباقي بروفات في تبويب تجريبية ولا تدخل في أرقام الأداء»، والتبويب المذكور قابل للضغط. اختفى الترقيم الوهمي الذي كان يشير إلى صفحات غير موجودة، وحلّ محل المفتاح المعطّل مؤشّر حالة صادق، وصار بإمكانك نقل أي إطلاق بين «فعلية» و«تجريبية» بضغطة من الصف نفسه بدل أمر تقني مصادق عليه. جرّبت ذلك فعليًا على الحملة رقم ٥ وتأكدت من تغيّر السجل، ثم أعدت الوضع تمامًا كما كان: الحملة ٥ فعلية، وما عداها تجريبي. وتحققت بنفسي أن حارس كتالوج الخدمات صار يوقف النشر عند أي انحراف دون أن يُسقط المحرّك — الخدمة تبقى تعمل، والإيقاف («إيقاف») يبقى سالكًا.

ومع ذلك لم أقبل هذه الجولة، لسببين يظهران أمام فريقك مباشرة. الأول: عند أي عرض أضيق من ٩٠٠ بكسل — جهاز لوحي، أو نافذة متصفح غير مكبَّرة، أو جوالك حين يتنقل بين أيدي الحاضرين — تنزلق قيم الصف تحت عناوين خاطئة، فيقرأ الحاضر «الجمهور: ٪٠» لحملة وصلت فعليًا إلى أربع عيادات. المشكلة ليست في الأرقام بل في العناوين فوقها، وإصلاحها سطر واحد في التنسيق. الثاني: صفحة تفاصيل الحملة — وهي أول ما تفتحه بعد القائمة — ما زالت تخلط الأرقام العربية والإنجليزية في الشريط نفسه: «٤ من ٤» بجانب «الكل (٤)». توحيد الأرقام تمّ في القائمة وحدها، ولم يمتد إلى الشاشة التالية لها. وثالثًا، وهو داخلي لكنه يخصّك: ملف أدلة الجودة وصف ثلاث مقارنات بصرية بأنها «مقارنة حقيقية مع مرجع مجمَّد»، وهي في الحقيقة تقارن البناء بنفسه؛ صحّحت التوصيف لأن معيارنا معك هو نفسه المكتوب على شاشاتك: «لا تقديرات».

الثلاثة إصلاحات سطحية لا تحتاج إعادة تصميم. القائمة نفسها — الشاشة التي طلبت إصلاحها — عبرت.
